[P2] Allow partial collection after a verified no-work start failure

When a fixture is unavailable, `start()` deletes the empty case, but the coordinator still invokes `collect_partial()` after `NotImplementedError`. This lookup raises, causing a cleanup error and target quarantine despite successful retirement. `finish(quiescent=False)` then retains the persistent fence, blocking later cases and runs. Return empty partial evidence for verified no-work failures, or retain an explicit no-work state. Add a coordinator regression using the actual `SharedAdapter`: the new missing-fixture coordinator test overrides `collect_partial()` to return `{}`, bypassing this defect.
